title: Soul Drinker
author: ben-counter
description: The Soul Drinkers, a proud successor Chapter of the Imperial Fists, recover the Soulspear — a long-lost relic of their founder. When the Inquisition moves to take it from them, betrayal and bloodshed set the Chapter on a path that will see them branded Excommunicate Traitoris.

title: The Bleeding Chalice
author: ben-counter
description: Mutated by an unknown affliction and hunted by the Imperium, the Soul Drinkers search for a cure for the curse that is consuming their Chapter. Chapter Master Sarpedon leads his battle-brothers on a quest that will take them to the edge of damnation — and beyond.

title: Crimson Tears
author: ben-counter
description: Sarpedon and the Soul Drinkers confront an Imperial Assassin and the machinations of an Inquisitor who has spent years plotting their destruction. As the Chapter fights for survival, the line between renegade and traitor blurs with every choice they make.

title: Chapter War
author: ben-counter
description: A rival faction of Soul Drinkers splinters from Sarpedon's force, and what begins as a schism becomes a full Chapter war. Brother fights brother across ruined worlds as the Chapter's soul is contested by those who would reclaim their loyalty to the Imperium and those who will not.

title: Hellforged
author: ben-counter
description: The Soul Drinkers raid a daemon world, seeking ancient weapons with which to fight the Imperium that has branded them traitors. In the forges of hell, Sarpedon's Chapter must descend ever deeper into corruption to survive — and the question becomes whether they can still come back.

title: Phalanx
author: ben-counter
description: Captured at last, Sarpedon is brought before a tribunal of Imperial Fists aboard their mobile fortress-monastery Phalanx to answer for the crimes of the Soul Drinkers. The final trial of the Chapter becomes a violent reckoning that no Astartes aboard the great ship will forget.
